leads.source_name: Ohio Secretary of State early and absentee voting dashboard
leads.evidence: Ohio Secretary of State confirms daily reporting from 88 county boards and county drilldown; dashboard is a JavaScript application and no aggregate machine-readable endpoint has yet been validated. Voter-level download must not be ingested.

leads.source_name: Georgia Early Vote Dashboard (third-party rendering of official data)
leads.evidence: Displays county early ballots and states source is official Georgia accepted-ballot data; original official downloadable source still needs verification

leads.source_name: Arizona Secretary of State 2026 election information
leads.evidence: Official election-information page, but election-night drop-off counts are not current early-vote county ballot totals
County-level vote totals and mail/in-person modes with documented Oct 25 cutoff; requires source and licensing review
